meanings: 【名詞】通路、廊下（a way through or along something, especially underground）
【名詞】一節、段落（a section of text or speech）
【名詞】通行、移動の行為（the process or right to pass through a place）
【名詞】航海、船旅（a journey by ship across the sea）
